CREATE TRIGGER review_cases_project_field_facts AFTER INSERT ON review_cases BEGIN INSERT INTO review_case_field_facts(review_case_id,destination,unresolved_choice,manual_bibliographic_attention,has_owner_decision_actions) SELECT NEW.review_case_id,json_extract(result.value,'$.destination'),CASE WHEN json_extract(result.value,'$.outcome')='unresolved_choice' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN json_extract(result.value,'$.destination') IN ('title','subtitle','series') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.document,'$.results') sibling WHERE json_extract(sibling.value,'$.destination') IN ('title','subtitle','series') AND json_array_length(json_extract(sibling.value,'$.reasons'))=1 AND json_extract(sibling.value,'$.reasons[0]')='no_safe_bibliographic_combination') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,CASE WHEN (json_extract(result.value,'$.outcome') IN ('propose_change','acceptable_choice','unresolved_choice') OR (json_extract(result.value,'$.destination') IN ('title','subtitle','series') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(NEW.document,'$.results') sibling WHERE json_extract(sibling.value,'$.destination') IN ('title','subtitle','series') AND json_array_length(json_extract(sibling.value,'$.reasons'))=1 AND json_extract(sibling.value,'$.reasons[0]')='no_safe_bibliographic_combination'))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(result.value,'$.alternatives') alternative WHERE json_extract(alternative.value,'$.assessment')<>'preserves_target') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM json_each(NEW.document,'$.results') result; END
